Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for a 2D fighting game.
The input image is ONLY a character identity/style reference, not a layout to copy. Preserve the exact teacher's face, hairstyle, costume, proportions and pixel-art outline. Create NEW action poses in an orderly atlas.
Output exactly 24 separate full-body sprites arranged in exactly FOUR ROWS and SIX COLUMNS on a completely transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Uniform 256x256 cells, no labels, no text, no borders, no shadows, no floor or background, no effects. Each cell contains exactly one complete figure with ALL hands/feet/props inside and 12px empty margins. Every figure faces screen RIGHT in side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Pixel-art, crisp controlled clusters, readable outline, matching the reference; not photorealistic.
CRITICAL ANATOMY AND REGISTRATION: exactly the SAME HEAD SIZE, torso length, limb thickness, costume and body scale in ALL 24 frames. Never scale a crouch or tucked air pose up to fill its cell. Standing figure approximately 190px tall; a crouch roughly 125px tall, proportionally shorter because knees/hips bend, not a smaller person. Standing feet sit on the same virtual baseline in every standing cell. Air attack figures keep the same head/torso size and leave transparent space below tucked feet. Body center should not wander horizontally across cells. Weapons remain attached to hands.
Each row is one six-frame coherent ACTION SEQUENCE in chronological order, not six identical isolated poses: frame1 ready/anticipate, frame2 clearly wind up, frame3 contact, frame4 full extension/follow-through, frame5 retract, frame6 recover to that row's ready pose. Clearly move arms, legs and torso across the six frames. Row1 standing action; Row2 stays CROUCHED for all six frames (start crouched, never stands); Row3 all six frames are AIRBORNE hand attack, no grounded stance; Row4 all six frames are AIRBORNE kick, no grounded stance. No duplicate row artwork.
Do not reproduce KOF characters or costume; these are original teacher sprites.
Character: Chan, female database teacher with long dark hair, black tee, blue jeans and sneakers.
ROW 1: compact crossfit elbow press with the rear forearm, keep both feet grounded.
ROW 2: deep squat short forward palm strike, never a sweeping kick.
ROW 3: jumping downward elbow with knees tucked.
ROW 4: hiking leap diagonal boot kick, one knee tucked.
